title: Sophie's World
author: Jostein Gaarder
summary: A fourteen-year-old girl starts receiving anonymous letters that ask big questions, and a mysterious teacher walks her through the history of Western philosophy. A strange puzzle about her own world slowly emerges.
readIf: you want a gentle, readable crash course in philosophy wrapped in an odd little mystery.
skipIf: you want a fast plot; long stretches are lectures on thinkers and ideas.

pairings.reason: A friendlier modern novel that also uses a fantastical frame to ask how to live well.
Another story where a reader slips into a book-like world and the line between story and life blurs.
Nested stories and big ideas for readers who want a more demanding puzzle.
